summary: Created the `appworker` account on node1 (RHEL 10) and configured its login session limits to 8,192 open files and 256 processes via /etc/security/limits.d/appworker.conf. Limits were verified live with ulimit, the node was rebooted, boot identity change was confirmed, and limits were re-verified after restart.
actions_performed: Created appworker user account with useradd
Wrote /etc/security/limits.d/appworker.conf with nofile=8192 and nproc=256 (soft and hard)
Verified limits via sudo -u appworker ulimit -n / ulimit -u
Polled until node1 became reachable again
Verified post-restart: sshd active, appworker account intact, limits still 8192/256

evidence.requirement: 8192 open files and 256 processes limits configured
evidence.summary: limits.d/appworker.conf written with nofile and nproc soft+hard values

evidence.requirement: Limits apply to appworker login sessions
evidence.summary: ulimit -n=8192 and ulimit -u=256 confirmed under appworker context

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery: services, account, and limits intact
evidence.summary: sshd active, appworker uid=1000, limits.conf unchanged, ulimit -n=8192 ulimit -u=256 confirmed
